sectionNote: one body under a navigation title: the file's preview (or its honest failure/unsupported card) plus the paging footer. The baseline groups nothing with Section/PageSection/GroupBox, so there is no section title to compare
titleNote: the navigation title is the file's last path component (`PreviewSurface.swift:296`), i.e. runtime data; the contract pins the actions and the states, not a literal title

source.sectionOrder: declaration order inside the page struct

android.note: the mirrored Swift type is `struct PreviewSurface`; the Android entry composable is `public fun PreviewPage(`, the alias this contract asserts. It lives outside `ui/page` because `PdshRoute.Preview` renders it as the app's one preview face, not as a page-layer screen

handRegistered.reason: `PreviewSurface` is not a `*Page` struct, so the extractor does not generate a contract for it (PR15 made the preview a standalone surface, `PreviewSurface.swift:231`, replacing the `FilePreviewPage` that used to hide inside `FilesPage.swift`). The surface is still a real entrance with its own actions, so it gets a hand-written contract instead of disappearing from the gate.
handRegistered.mechanism: a whole contract file, not a `_spec-required.json` entry: that file merges items into a contract the extractor generated, and no extracted contract exists for this page. `extract_ios_pages.py` never writes or deletes `pages/preview-surface.json` (`discover_pages` walks `*Page` structs only), and `page_structure_check.py` reads it like every other contract, provenance included.
handRegistered.scope: the actions the Android entry composable implements. Three baseline controls stay outside this contract's Android comparison set, on purpose: 关闭 (`PreviewSurface.swift:327`) is drawn only for the modal presentation, and Android renders this surface as a pushed route whose frame back is that gesture; 网页网络权限 and 重新加载页面 (`:339`, `:345`) are HTML/page-source-only, and Android does not do an HTML preview — a second page source is blocked by the app-wide single-WebView invariant (§6.3-5; L28 §4) — so the three are not part of this contract's Android comparison set. Everything else the baseline renders a label for is listed above.

states.note: advisory only: these are the four rules the surface renders, recorded with provenance; the checker compares actions and sections, never this object

data.renders: the body for the resolved kind (text / markdown / image / PDF / video)
data.when: model.isLoading == false && model.error == nil && the kind has a renderer

failure.renders: 无法预览 + the host reason + 重试

unknown.renders: 暂时不能预览这个文件 + why + 分享文件
unknown.anchor: Text("暂时不能预览这个文件")

warnings: not generated by extract_ios_pages.py: PreviewSurface is a standalone surface, not a *Page struct (see handRegistered)
